title: Can You Mount A Ring Video Doorbell Sideways? - BGR
summary: Even the Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro , the company's flagship doorbell, is capped at 140 degrees for its horizontal axis. The Arlo Video Doorbell (2nd Gen) delivers a 180-degree FOV and costs quite a bit less than any Ring doorbell.
